verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can export content at any time, in Markdown (an open format) or Any-Block. The self-host guide describes exporting all channels and re-importing them into a new identity, which covers whole-knowledge-base export. The localhost API adds a programmatic path to the data. Missing for 10: documentation of what Markdown export preserves (properties, relations, database views, files), clarity on whether Any-Block is an open or documented format, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a full export works for leaving the product.
